enforcement.before: Eight admission commands; installation manifest 3; configuration validation was in-process only and path checks matched a textual UID segment.
enforcement.after: Eight admission commands and their decision/exit meanings remain unchanged. Administrative validate-configuration adds format-1 request/response with exit 0 valid, 2 invalid, 4 malformed/error; no effect permission. Manifest 4 and lossless shared-default bootstrap format 7 require reconciled installation readers, resolved owned path observations and a plan/revision/source-bound validation receipt before registration. Strict installation readers need an adapter update.
enforcement.rationale: R26 exposes configuration checks without changing admission semantics. Trusted adapters supply authenticated current path facts and revalidate exact plans inside conditional registration; templates provide transport, not authority or installed dispatch certification.
enforcement.already_satisfied: Actual administrative installation or equivalent reuse receipts, required native consent and restart, no unresolved real error, matching owned scope and checkpoint. Unknown original completion time remains unknown; missing dispatch evidence never blocks. SHA/status alone is insufficient.
enforcement.installation_status: Contract 2: migrate old pending states only from actual C/U/R/E receipts and contemporaneous consents, never labels alone. Reuse unchanged approvals without synthetic tests. BOOT-12 completes enforcement installation; BOOT-13 independently verifies only canonical machine registration; all technical status/receipts stay local. Preserve unknown historical completion time and record recognition time separately; uncertain metadata defers wrapper evolution only.
enforcement.recovery: Inspect actual active configuration and journal phase under an exclusive owned lock; preserve verified active on staging failure; reconcile activated_pending_checkpoint before advancement. Never remove ongoing/recovery code or advance peer adoption.
enforcement.retention: one active plus at most one ordinary transient candidate; no historical snapshots
enforcement.target_commit: Resolve containing OOP Git commit after publication; never a future self-SHA.

target_identity: Resolve obtained canonical repository/ref/full commit metadata; no future self-SHA.
unknown: Missing required descriptor/facts is UNKNOWN, never no-op.
